dogecoin.text: 🚨 BREAKING: Crypto bigwigs beg Congress for rules, saying the U.S. might fall behind countries that fully understand... um, Dogecoin? Ah yes, a national emergency—right up there with Bigfoot sightings and the McRib shortage. 🚀

Ah, RWA tokenization on Bitcoin! Finally, a way to turn real-world assets into digital tokens—because who wouldn’t want to trade a fraction of a parking garage like it’s a Dogecoin? Next up: tokenizing my grandma’s couch. Big market for that. 🚀
